summary.interpretation: Preliminary visual screening from contact sheets. A covers readable raised roadside wall/bank contacts, not flat shoulders. Broad B evidence concentrates around accepted-hairpin, adjacent canyon and Nudo massif. C means a separate distant terrain skyline/panorama region; the outline of the same B face remains protected by B and SILHOUETTE_CRITICAL without establishing C. Sea or sky alone is not C. No world-space identity, D classification, confirmed simplification, GEO_FIX diagnosis, natural material class, performance measurement or canonical tags are inferred. Absent means no independent evidence in this pair only. Owner review pending.

original_checks.observed_detail: Full-resolution frame shows a tall faceted roadside cut on the left, clear base/contact and top rollover, plus broad upper rock bands, ledges and a separate distant crest toward the right. Diagnostic colors do not establish material types.
original_checks.judgment_change_or_confirmation: Station 230 A-left and B-present confirmed. C-present remains supported by the screened pair; independent crest evidence exists without using the near-wall outline. No causal geometry diagnosis.

original_checks.observed_detail: Across the tight bend, a large wall face occupies nearly the whole upper frame, with a strong vertical convex corner and the adjoining stacked-road contacts. Background terrain is largely occluded by this face.
original_checks.judgment_change_or_confirmation: Station 267 A/B confirmed; C-absent in the preliminary pair retained. Preserve broad corner/planes and road contacts; detailed texel/checker appearance does not justify microscopic geometry.

original_checks.observed_detail: The central rocky massif has readable major ledges, vertical bands, peak and shoulder forms; its silhouette belongs to the same B massif. Near road edges in this view are architectural parapets, with low adjacent Landscape ground and a lower cut outside the deck.
